verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for a database product, so the axis applies. The evidence describes ObsessionDB as a managed hosting service that runs the official ClickHouse engine on a rebuilt storage layer, but nothing shows ObsessionDB's own code (storage layer, coordination layer, CHKit) is published under an open license. The open-source status of upstream ClickHouse is an underlying-engine fact and earns no credit here.
